description.name: Entry
description.text: Eight single attacks (0.78 each), grants [Haste], [Dual Blink 2], [Attach Dark] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Dual Blink 2
description.text: Evades the next 2 attacks that could be evaded with [Physical Blink] or [Magical Blink], lower priority than [Physical Blink] and [Magical Blink]

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
